lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Mummy Pig's Birthday. Today is Mummy Pig's birthday.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈的生日。今天是猪妈妈的生日。

lines.en: Daddy Pig has made Mummy Pig breakfast in bed. Happy birthday, Mummy Pig. Peppa and George have made Mummy Pig a birthday card. Happy birthday, Mummy.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸给猪妈妈做了床上早餐。生日快乐，猪妈妈。佩奇和乔治给猪妈妈做了一张生日卡片。妈妈，生日快乐。

lines.en: Oh, what a lovely birthday surprise. And there are more surprises to come. Enjoy your birthday breakfast. Take your time.
lines.zh: 哦，多么可爱的生日惊喜。还有更多惊喜等着你呢。好好享用你的生日早餐。别着急。

lines.en: Mmm, yummy. Quick, we have to get everything else ready.
lines.zh: 嗯，真好吃。快点，我们得把别的东西都准备好。

lines.en: Daddy Pig has made a birthday cake for Mummy Pig. Oh, we've just got to put the candles on.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸给猪妈妈做了一个生日蛋糕。哦，我们只要把蜡烛插上就行了。

lines.en: One, two. Here I come. Mummy Pig has finished her birthday breakfast.
lines.zh: 一、二。我来了。猪妈妈吃完她的生日早餐了。

lines.en: Mummy's coming. Oh no, we're not ready yet. Uh, who is it? It's Mummy. Can I come in? No. No. Is there something secret going on? Uh, no. Nothing's going on. But you can't come in.
lines.zh: 妈妈来了。哦不，我们还没准备好。呃，谁呀？是妈妈。我可以进来吗？不行。不行。是不是有什么秘密的事？呃，没有。什么都没有。但是你不能进来。

lines.en: I see. Mummy Pig, why don't you relax in the sitting room? That sounds nice. Well, it is your birthday.
lines.zh: 我明白了。猪妈妈，你去客厅休息一下好吗？听起来不错。嗯，今天是你生日嘛。

lines.en: Okay, Peppa, I think I know where the sitting room is. Here's a nice magazine. Thank you, Peppa. And here's some pretty music. Thank you, Peppa.
lines.zh: 好吧，佩奇，我想我知道客厅在哪里。这儿有一本好看的杂志。谢谢你，佩奇。还有好听的音乐。谢谢你，佩奇。

lines.en: We need the same number of candles as Mummy's age. One, two, three. Oh dear, we haven't got nearly enough candles. Daddy, how old is Mummy? I'll whisper it in your ear. Wow, really old.
lines.zh: 我们需要和妈妈年龄一样多的蜡烛。一、二、三。哦，天哪，我们的蜡烛远远不够。爸爸，妈妈多少岁了？我悄悄告诉你。哇，好老啊。

lines.en: You know, I think three candles will be fine. Mummy Pig's birthday cake is ready. Hooray! We just have to put up the decorations in the sitting room.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，我觉得三根蜡烛就够了。猪妈妈的生日蛋糕做好了。太好啦！我们只要在客厅挂上装饰就行了。

lines.en: Hello, Mummy. Oh, there you all are. I was getting a little bored. Mummy, would you like to have a nice walk in the garden?
lines.zh: 你好，妈妈。哦，你们都在呀。我有点无聊了。妈妈，你想去花园里散散步吗？

lines.en: Do I have any choice? Nope. Bye-bye, Mummy. Have a lovely walk. We'll call you when it's safe to come back in.
lines.zh: 我有别的选择吗？没有。再见，妈妈。散步愉快。安全了我们就叫你进来。

lines.en: I've forgotten what hard work birthdays were.
lines.zh: 我都忘了过生日是这么辛苦的事。

lines.en: Daddy Pig, Peppa, and George are decorating the sitting room.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸、佩奇和乔治在装饰客厅。

lines.en: This is fun.
lines.zh: 真好玩。

lines.en: Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig have arrived for Mummy Pig's birthday.
lines.zh: 猪奶奶和猪爷爷来给猪妈妈过生日了。

lines.en: Happy birthday, Mummy Pig. Aren't you coming inside? Oh, I can't come in yet. Daddy Pig, Peppa, and George are doing secret things for my birthday.
lines.zh: 生日快乐，猪妈妈。你不进来吗？哦，我还不能进去。猪爸爸、佩奇和乔治正在为我的生日做秘密的事。

lines.en: How lovely. See you later. Bye.
lines.zh: 真好。待会儿见。再见。

lines.en: Mummy, would you like to come inside now? I'd love to. Close your eyes. Keep your eyes closed, Mummy.
lines.zh: 妈妈，你现在想进来吗？非常想。闭上眼睛。妈妈，眼睛要一直闭着哦。

lines.en: One, two, three. Open your eyes. Happy birthday, Mummy.
lines.zh: 一、二、三。睁开眼睛吧。妈妈，生日快乐。

lines.en: What a lovely surprise. Blow the candles out and make a wish.
lines.zh: 多么美好的惊喜。吹蜡烛许个愿吧。

lines.en: Mummy. Mummy, open your present. Can you guess what it is? I have no idea. Open it and see.
lines.zh: 妈妈。妈妈，打开你的礼物吧。你能猜到是什么吗？我完全不知道。打开看看就知道了。

lines.en: It's a beautiful dress.
lines.zh: 是一条漂亮的裙子。

lines.en: You're beautiful, Mummy. Now you just need somewhere nice to wear it. What's this? Two tickets to the theater tonight.
lines.zh: 妈妈，你真漂亮。现在你只需要一个穿它的好地方。这是什么？两张今晚的剧院门票。

lines.en: Thank you. Mummy Pig loves going to the theater. And Granny Pig and I are going to babysit the little ones.
lines.zh: 谢谢。猪妈妈喜欢去剧院。我和猪奶奶来照看两个小家伙。

lines.en: Hooray.
lines.zh: 太好啦。

lines.en: What a super birthday. I'm the luckiest Mummy in the whole world and the most beautiful.
lines.zh: 多么棒的生日。我是全世界最幸运的妈妈，也是最漂亮的妈妈。
